ABOUT PLAYSCOUT

Sources and ranking methodology

How rankings, changing facts, screenshots and external videos should be collected and verified.

Source hierarchy

Production facts should prefer official store APIs, publisher sites and first-party patch notes. Licensed chart providers may supply ranking snapshots. Reputable creator videos and player communities add experience, but they do not override first-party facts.

Ranking fields

Store rank, chart movement, editorial heat and recommendation status remain separate. Every changing value needs a region, platform, observed time and source record. The public page shows the last successful update and a stale state when a feed fails.

Images and video

Use publisher-approved press assets, store artwork through permitted APIs, owned screenshots, or licensed images. Keep YouTube videos on the original host using a specific video ID and link back to the creator.

Collection workflow

  1. Fetch only permitted fields at a respectful rate.
  2. Store source URL, external ID and observation time.
  3. Normalize game identity without erasing the source record.
  4. Send meaningful changes to editorial review.
  5. Publish only pages that meet the index-quality threshold.
TRANSPARENCY
